text: I feel a quiet curiosity here, surrounded by the marks of intellectual pursuit. The glass-walled room reflects my own image back at me, emphasizing separation from and longing for deeper conversation. As I move closer to the vibrant R+D display, I sense a merging of science and creativity—a celebration of experiment and progress. This awakens hope, tempered with the knowledge that every new innovation emerges from questioning the familiar. Today, I am both an observer and a participant, quietly thrilled by humanity's restless inventiveness.
